_comment: Animation output contract v1.0 — source of truth for all workers. Do not edit without orchestrator sign-off. Schema note: each animation entry may carry an optional 'framePrompts' array (one string per frame, 0-indexed) that stores the base prompt used when that frame was last generated. These are the starting point for per-frame prompt editing; runtime overrides are stored separately in data/frame-prompts.json keyed as 'character.animName.frameIndex'.
style: 16-bit pixel art, GBA style, bold BLACK pixel outlines

individual.description: One PNG per animation. All frames in a single horizontal row.

spritesheet.description: All animations packed into one PNG, one animation per row. Accompanied by a JSON metadata file.
spritesheet.frameOrder: left to right per row, top to bottom per animation
spritesheet.note: DISCREPANCY — individual files are the primary output. Spritesheet is a secondary aggregation. breezy-spritesheet.json predates this contract and uses 'row'/'y' keys. New spritesheets must match the schema below.

{animName}.y: number — top pixel of row (row * frameSize)
{animName}.width: number — row width in pixels (frames * frameSize)
